notes: Gogok of Swiftness below rank 25: the buff the player wears while Swiftness runs (fixed_2 seconds from the last hit, up to fixed_3 stacks). The record states one stack's Attack Speed (fixed_1) and the client shows the total for the stacks. The Dodge per stack depends on the rank, so it is the addon line (docs/contracts/buff-values-messages.md). Donor Aspect of the Cheetah, for its icon.

text: Increases Attack Speed by $s1% and Cooldown Reduction by $s2%.
notes: Gogok of Swiftness at rank 25: the same buff, whose record also states the Cooldown Reduction per stack (rank25_value_1). Two records because a record's text cannot depend on the rank. Donor Aspect of the Cheetah.

Taeguk below rank 25: damage per stack depends on the rank (2% + 0.04% per rank), so the record states no number; the addon line has the total. Up to fixed_2 stacks, fixed_1 seconds from the last channeled tick. Donor Arcane Power.

text: Increases the damage you deal and increases your Armor by $s1%.
notes: Taeguk at rank 25: also states the Armor per stack (rank25_value_1). Donor Arcane Power.

Invigorating Gemstone: healing received per stack depends on the rank (1% + 0.02% per rank), so the record states no number; the addon line has the total. Up to fixed_2 stacks, fixed_1 seconds from the last hit. Donor Rejuvenation.
Bane of the Powerful: fixed_1 % damage for the gem's rank seconds (the aura's own timer) after an elite kill. One stack. Donor Recklessness.

Pain Enhancer rank 25, Blood Frenzy: rank25_value_1 % Attack Speed per bleeding enemy in reach; the stack count is the number of bleeding enemies, so the client shows the total. 255 is the most a stack counter holds (one byte), not a game number. No timer: it follows the count. Donor Bloodrage.

text: Resistances to Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison and Arcane increased by $s1%.
notes: Esoteric Alteration rank 25: rank25_value_2 % to the five resistances while Life is under rank25_value_1 %. One stack, no timer: on while Life is low. Donor Fire Resistance Aura.

text: Part of the damage you take is put off and dealt to you over time.
notes: Moratorium: on while damage is owed. The amount owed is live, so it is the addon line (docs/contracts/buff-values-messages.md). Donor Shield Wall, the combat-log shell's own donor (83404).
